reports.title: MARQETA REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: Financial Guidance
section: The following summarizes Marqeta's guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026 and full year of 2026:

Fourth Quarter 2026 | Fiscal Year 2026
Net Revenue Growth | 3 - 5% | 11 - 12%
Gross Profit Growth | 5 - 7% | 11 - 12%
Adjusted EBITDA Growth (1) | Mid 20s | Low-to-Mid 30s
